title: the sand pours on the bar
story: Mayonesa's intro is a dense reggaeton groove at about 96 bpm with no clean dembow: the strong hits sit on beats 1 and 3, on the offbeat 16ths and on beats 2 and 4. The opening hit at 33 (onset 53.5) pours the sand, then each bar pours from the other side of origen_x, and each hit class keeps its own float: kicks ghost the glass, offbeat strokes flash the lime palette, backbeats shake the box, and the top hits drain the sand in an avalanche. Colour sways every two beats and the background tint steps every bar, so the picture keeps the groove through the whole intro.
